name: r4-portfolio-google-material
description: Portfolio SPA de Francisco Robledo con estética Google Material You, animaciones fluidas y persistencia en base de datos SQLite.

scripts.start: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true})"

author: Francisco Robledo
